question: The RAM in a computer is located in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mother Board**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **RAM is located in Motherboard**__.

 __
 
• A **motherboard is a printed circuit board and foundation of a computer that is the biggest board in a computer chassis**.
 
• The **motherboard is the largest board in a computer'**s chassis and is responsible for connecting all the computer's components
 
• It a**llocates power and allows communication to and between the CPU, RAM,** and all other computer hardware components.
 
• It is the backbone of a computer and ties all components together.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Random Access Memory (RAM)**

 
 
• It stores data that the computer needs to use temporarily.
 
• It is a volatile memory i.e. the data disappear from it when the power is off.
 
• There are two main types of RAM: dynamic random access memory (DRAM), or Dynamic RAM, and static random access memory (SRAM).
 
 
 
• **An expansion card is an electronic card/board that is used to add extra functionality to a computer.**
 
 
• It is inserted into an expansion slot on the motherboard of a computer.
 
• Expansion cards contain edge connectors that are used to create an electronic link between motherboard and card, thus enabling these two to communicate.
